A separate salvage receipt can succeed while the original operation remains incomplete; a single `salvaged_resolved` flag should not erase that distinction.

An import path should record source and processing for native embedded images, page/region renders, raster crops, and script-produced derivatives. Native images preserve original encoding/dimensions, including JPEG; crops concern parent pixels and lossless output; vector/composite PDF renders concern page/region/render parameters/readability. One mandatory page/bbox/DPI field set does not fit all types. Management/provenance records do not prove a crop retained the right panel, legend, or labels; preserve source-led quality checks without imposing a new per-image approval ritual.

A preview record identifies generated pixels for a fixed target revision. A review record identifies what was actually inspected, its source, scope, aspect, and unresolved issues. Do not auto-create a passing layout review because Chromium produced an image. Candidate/draft previews remain useful before final mapping or full document completion.

Avoid marking an entire page and all dependencies invalid after any edit. Distinguish characters/numbers, meaningful styles, reading/cross-page relations, crop content, and rendered layout. Unchanged characters do not prove full text fidelity when superscripts, footnote placement, or emphasis changes. Adding table rows may alter shared header/unit/footnote scope. Preserve unaffected checks where justified and guide targeted reevaluation without a universal quality engine or compulsory review gate.

topic: Version dependencies for previews and exports
summary: Running `update_draft` and an implicit-latest preview concurrently can inspect old content while the agent believes it saw the new revision. Return `produced_revision`, then let the agent choose that version for readback/preview/export. An optional document-level commit-plus-preview operation may reduce a round, but reports commit and preview outcomes separately; preview failure is not edit failure. A generic `after_batch_mutation` scheduler brings ambiguity with multiple edits, failed edits, stale bases, and recovery, and was not made first-version necessary. Explicitly viewing old content or a rejected candidate remains useful.

Missing emphasis can originate in source interpretation, Markdown markup, or rendering. Access to both source pixels and the exact saved revision helps locate the failure. A `render_regions([{page,bbox,label},...])` capability can inspect confusable glyphs, headings, superscripts, or neighboring emphasis. Return independent images or a contact sheet at the agent's choice; keep labels outside source pixels, sufficient context, per-region provenance, originals, and exact rereads.

One contact sheet may be cheaper/clearer than several images, or worse if it makes each glyph too small; bytes alone do not decide. Proposed ink/stroke ratio hints are reproducible measurements but not reliable bold labels without evidence: Chinese characters naturally differ in density, and size, bbox alignment, background, bleed, binarization, or hidden OCR misalignment affect values. Keep such output as optional “visual difference worth checking” hints, not per-span mandatory numeric noise or a first-version prerequisite. Exact local original-pixel comparison has the more direct value.

topic: App responsibility does not mean custom mechanism
summary: The app decides what must be preserved, accepted, and displayed; a framework may implement messages, persistence, turn boundaries, summaries, cancellation, or middleware that calls a centralized policy. Declaring all session/provider/context/lifecycle work app-owned and then saying the runtime is only a while-loop prejudges the comparison. Conversely, if integration really replaces most features, a thinner runtime can be sensible. Compare reusable mechanisms, state/exception paths to maintain, public-interface stability, diagnostics, and upgrade cost, not only low interference or adapter line count.

topic: Single policy without one giant hook
summary: Avoid independent app and framework compressors maintaining competing active contexts. It does not follow that all logic must sit in one hook. Similarly, converting through framework message types does not inherently destroy images or encrypted reasoning: verify required information survives and the final native request is correct. Hook names alone do not establish Nexus compatibility or crash safety.

In the checked 0.7.29 version, size offloading was in `FilesystemMiddleware`, with public `tool_token_limit_before_evict=None` and same-name replacement mechanisms; configuration is not rewriting the entire middleware. Summarization offered prompt/counting/custom-summarizer options. Pi also has automatic compaction policy to coordinate. Deep Agents has TypeScript as well as Python variants, requiring version-specific checks. Since v0.7 task planning/`write_todos` was optional, the claimed mandatory Todo removal cost was wrong. No measured “context advantages become zero” conclusion followed.

topic: Generic workspace tools and formal artifacts
summary: They can prepare long drafts, notes, scripts, and intermediate outputs. Workspace Markdown is working material; formal versions come through the document service. Do not point generic tools directly at internal version storage or automatically treat any file as a published artifact. Retain agent script/file freedom rather than remove it to simplify a framework comparison. `create_agent` was attractive for opting into only needed tools, not because generic file tools are intrinsically incompatible.

topic: Public interfaces and inaccurate recovery APIs
summary: Deep Agents `_get_effective_messages` was internal, not a stable extension contract; public model/tool middleware was preferred. Pi's request `context`/`context_with_system`, compaction hooks, and `context_edit` do not themselves create an app transaction. Pi v1.3.0 examples used `SessionManager.open()` and `createAgentSession()`, not `Session.load()`; persisted tool results were message entries with role `toolResult`. Tool `execute()` returns `AgentToolResult {content, details}`, not a session-entry object. `getEntry/getEntries/getBranch` provide public reads. Direct JSONL surgery was rejected.

LangGraph `update_state()` creates a new checkpoint, applies reducers, and `as_node` affects subsequent execution; it is not merely appending a ToolMessage, so hiding repair side effects in `get_tuple()` was rejected. Public `get_state/get_state_history` can inspect without parsing private storage. Pi's low-level `Agent.continue()` can reject when the last message is assistant and no queued message exists; that refutes an automatic-pending-tool-resume assumption, not Pi's overall suitability. A hook mapping alone cannot establish equal integration cost.

This segment moved from Pi versus Deep Agents to Pi versus selective `create_agent`, then prioritized `create_agent` with persistent LangGraph checkpoints to reduce custom recovery responsibilities. Plain `create_agent` does not include `FilesystemMiddleware` by default. These were design priorities, not app-level compatibility or performance results. The later final consolidation chooses a small direct `StateGraph` plus native Nexus service and document/evidence core, superseding the middleware-centered assembly while retaining useful state and projection boundaries.

topic: Native Nexus behavior without a second retry owner
summary: The conversation valued native Chat Completions/Responses encoding, tool-image pairing, encrypted reasoning where used, complete-response validation, safe diagnostics, persistent attempts, and attempt-local SSE assembly without partial JSON execution or cross-attempt concatenation. Context is app-controlled and does not require upstream native compaction. The final shared service is used for ordinary inference and consolidation with the same budget/cancellation rules; it does not assume remote cancellation, background result retrieval, or known cost after unknown outcomes.

topic: Old transport cannot be wrapped as an automatic guarantee
summary: The v1 retry ledger lived in `Agent.model_round`, while Chat image pairing depended on `Provider.pending_images`/`flush_images`; they were not all in one HTTP function. A `NexusWireChatModel` wrapper could be a useful historical adapter option, but would not inherit 228 tests or every old guarantee automatically. Isolate request/batch state, preserve native-response/framework mappings, and use one retry owner. Generic `ChatOpenAI` retries are configurable and it supports images/Responses; the specific risk is unpreserved third-party fields and actual route behavior, not an established claim it breaks everything.

topic: Frozen input and bounded unknown outcomes
summary: For an eligible transient transport failure, reuse the frozen logical request rather than re-resolve live pins or change the prefix. Keep each attempt, diagnostics, response candidate, usage if known, and unknown fees/settlement when appropriate. Permanent configuration/authentication errors and user cancellation do not gain blind retries. Capacity correction needs the explicit context path. Earlier examples of automatic retries 2/three attempts described optional configurations, not a new default or renewed authorization for model calls.

topic: Model switching preserves unresolved modality needs
summary: Check target context, image/tool/protocol capabilities, prepare the transferable state, validate the actual request, then activate. Removing images can make a text model's request valid while losing evidence for emphasis, legends, or superscripts; OCR is not universally equivalent. Retain unresolved visual requirements and block only unsupported operations, allowing useful text/script work or an available vision route. A font name alone must not impose mandatory page-by-page visual gates. Model rules and calibration do not silently carry across routes.

`query_visual_evidence` can use a configured vision route and retain question, exact images/regions, model, response, and uncertainty as derived evidence. Allow crop, whole page, or multiple related pages so a forced crop does not remove a header/legend. Raw pixels remain source evidence. Such a tool does not automatically certify its model's interpretation, create a required workflow, or authorize additional paid model calls during this reconstruction.

One agent switching sections or optional sequential episodes/subagents can carry effective requirements, current versions/candidates, unfinished scopes, unresolved cross-section relations, and the same task budget/records. No page threshold mandates episodes. Sharing a budget does not enlarge its time/round allowance; separate budgets change policy. Subgraphs can provide execution-local persistence, but do not choose handoff content, merge documents, or judge completion automatically. Heavy OCR/images remain in evidence storage; child checkpoints store state/references, and the parent receives exact outputs and remaining issues rather than an unverifiable completion summary.

topic: Seven-step scenario is a fixture not workflow
summary: Survey across pages, save an unfinished table, fix metadata/header, preview the same revision, compact, continue editing, and interrupt after a commit form a useful scenario. They do not prescribe how every PDF is converted. A scripted mock model may finish without reading the new context at all, so a successful sequence alone does not establish correct handoff, source fidelity, or agent autonomy.

Useful checks include exact compact-encoding round trips; final assembled requirements/current state/unresolved references; precise evidence and pixel retrieval; original receipts without duplicate edits; complete tool pairing; and expected activation behavior at interruption boundaries. An exception can run `finally`/flush and is not a hard process kill; broken IPC may leave a subprocess working. Fixture tests establish scoped mechanisms, not live model reasoning, comprehensive Nexus behavior, lower equal-quality cost, or the best framework. “Two hours to prove the winner” and adapter line count were not reliable acceptance criteria.

A source-led saved/reopened/exported check concerns the intended PDF or complete section, image fidelity, meaningful formatting, correct content, and reusable output. Natural autonomy does not require the agent to exercise import, release, visual delegation, or preview correction merely to demonstrate features. Final design acceptance is consistent contracts and clear ownership; later implementation needs suitable offline checks and actual source comparison. These retrospective suggested experiments are not current standing permission or a queued benchmark matrix.

topic: Three final contracts and bounded scope
summary: Document edits must define exact references, changed fields, preservation of unspecified content, and commit success. Capacity/handoff must define sendable, release-needed, consolidation-needed, and still-too-large states without losing unprocessed history or destroying originals. Persistence/recovery must name owners and behavior at saved request, accepted response, committed tool, and recorded graph boundaries; reconcile frozen requests and historical receipts without budget reset or head rollback. Unknown local effects preserve work and stop when unreconcilable; explicit user questions wait. Speculative hard-crash universality, automatic truncated-call salvage, universal reminders, and automatic packaging on every exit are not necessary additions.

Markdown, JSON, HTML, images, and ZIP should correspond to one selected version; stopped execution, an agent's completion statement, and export consistency are separate records. Existing saved versions can export without another model request, with incomplete work clearly marked as draft. If delivery means an installable desktop product, interface/backend integration and Windows packaging remain real delivery work, not reasons to reopen context architecture. The preferred architecture is still unimplemented; this reference preserves design knowledge without importing closed v1 job allowances or treating old test logs as new acceptance.
Preserve correct rejected text; logical output blocks do not prescribe storage granularity, and exact matching does not certify semantic correctness.
Version-bound expected text, immutable candidate successors, atomic base-snapshot nonoverlapping patches, optional lines/ranges/locations; character-index conventions need definition.
Page-27 本文件→本文作 and emphasis/glyph review motivate reuse; eight historical tool errors cannot all be eliminated by patching.
Version-bound paired images/crops/montages with outside-pixel labels; no proven memory/downsampling diagnosis or guaranteed error detection.
Page-only or multiple-region references remain valid; immutable evidence plus internal location prevents unstable p14_b03 identity; avoid mandatory per-word bboxes.
Separate original bytes, actual selected/repeated input, and route/output reserve; huge OCR and timeout observations do not prove causality.
P had selective/checkpoint off; non-use cannot establish no need, no awareness, or failure to adopt.
Shared exact/full/field/range access and per-result sizes; external host capacity/history are outside server control; no forced compact/text-first gate.
Optional release/pin intent, no omission-triggered release; ordinary dialogue and unsaved decisions also need protection.
Partial model updates/internal sparse storage coexist with complete derived source maps; task-specific outside_scope does not persist across all tasks.
Page flag/block existence is not content completeness; section-level task scope, blank versus omitted, and none versus unknown remain distinct.
Share data/handoff views, while distinguishing same-run compaction, child/new task delegation, and same-run restart recovery.
Stable batch identity avoids repeated settlement; replay must not regress later policy. Small policy moves to Graph State with one settlement point.
Sent requests/budgets, committed versions and external effects retain durable owners; reducers and one physical database do not guarantee correctness.
Input view, actual attempt, accepted parent reply and tool operation are different IDs; accepted batch identity is essential.
Legacy provider images and round state cannot simply become stateless; use request-local native protocol encoding.
Local preflight differs from sends; capacity resend allowance and retry count are distinct policy choices sharing durable totals; honor recognized errors and Retry-After.
Inspection/salvage cannot implicitly terminate; stable snapshot/decoding and Job Objects were proposed, not required V1 machinery.
Product priority does not dictate layered construction; smallest useful save/reopen/export flow preserves candidates immediately; no new trial is authorized.
Mandatory NFC/HTML reformatting rejected; U+2F800 normalization example and whitespace effects qualify losslessness. Preserve raw content and use mapped edit views.
Cell locators may reuse patch engine; row/col ambiguity and first occurrence default require exact version-bound location; 95% claim unproven.
Save complete arguments before framework validation, raw native replies separately, and successful receipts despite later response projection errors; shared across interfaces.
Incomplete drafts remain saveable/previewable/exportable with gaps; technical validity and content completion are separate, no required extra write call.
Completion binds scope and version; source inventory/provenance/claims distinct; printed labels may be corrected; copyright pages not inherently omittable.
Large 191662-character inspect belonged to an accepted task; A emphasis defects 16/18/24, C also 14 and glyph; interface-friction causality unproven.
Trusted accepted-parent call indices produce deterministic intent settlement; this does not order actual operations.
Framework parallel sends and pending-writes restoration invalidate naive in-memory sequence locks; explicit versions and receipts, small sequential node preferred when needed.
Whole-document parse preserves cross-block references; DOM/source mapping and screenshots are not guaranteed by a five-line wrapper; no fixed DPI or mandatory paired images.
150-line/100%-protection and transferred 228-test claims withdrawn; actual native message order, executable calls and request-local artifacts require integration.
Durable logical step lookup reuses accepted reply across checkpoint gap; don't rehydrate released artifact images.
Observable save/reuse/read/export/resume outcome, not module count or arbitrary page cut; context continuation remains unimplemented obligation, not automatic test queue.
Direct whole-batch/recovery ownership justifies StateGraph; fixed three/four nodes and BaseChatModel wrapper not requirements.
Namespace/counter collision at branch and END; durable new IDs for new input/regeneration, same ID/frozen input for recovery; prepare not automatically revisited.
Checkpoint references immutable prepared request, full configuration/schema/content fingerprint; no accepted reply does not imply unsent request; sync doesn't prove remote once-only.
Embedded operation identity useful; prepared version folder differs from committed pointer, short transaction owns registration/head/receipt; started unknown effects still need records.
Shared dispatcher alone insufficient; installed 2.3.0 intercept_tool_call avoided broad schema weakening; capture only app-received decoded calls.
html_block ignores attrs, footnotes absent, M:N DOM relations possible; expanded CSS screenshots cannot stand for actual reading.
Basic input limits and large-result preservation early; history overflow requires reserved compaction room; route estimates imperfect and full first access retained.
Deliver selected version/scope, not latest; app can export without model; old candidate presence doesn't force repair; clarification waits.
Defined block operations, candidate override/arrays/per-page upsert, new identity for corrected input; unspecified fields must survive.
Exact pointer/block reuse from blocks or block_ops differs from replaying deletion/reorder/patch intent; indexing follows raw capture.
Later unrelated success doesn't resolve older candidate; immutable originals and scoped partial-use relations, no per-fragment mandatory disposition.
Ancestor adoption is historical provenance, not proof of current content/work completion; general branch management not V1 prerequisite.
Manifest atomic replacement doesn't prove complete durability or prevent stale overwrite; SQLite metadata preferred with preserved prepared files.
Old operation receipt remains valid after head/selection advances; replay must not reapply or regress pointers; frozen request stays historical.
Restore all completed/pending accepted calls and intents before assembling the next new request; one successful edit receipt is insufficient.
Save/select/export/render have different preconditions; bind omitted versions once before execution; export old version independently of current head.

topic: Concurrency versus replay and attempt retention
summary: OCR/render write files/processes; no tool-name-only matrix; preserve useful attempt files and verify parameters before reuse.
Source PDF render requires no draft; artifact hash alone doesn't verify source/region/DPI identity.
Rejected local estimate is not model context specification; route-local observations and bounded shared totals, not reset per new step.

topic: Accounted compaction requests and service gate
summary: Semantic compaction is a durable budgeted model call; shared service checks every actual send and can recover accepted results with zero new budget.
Track actual source range, prior summary, unprocessed remainder, revision; preserve call-result pairing; invalid/stale summary cannot replace originals.
140k→100k can apply before 80k final target; evaluate full changed view including anchors; fixed prefix/2–3 passes not universal correctness.
Differential summary loses dependencies if anchor changes; explicit stable fields or self-contained handoff recommended; scope sufficient to continue.
Old tool-call body payloads count too; preserve original execution records, choose relevance-based view, no immediate-withdraw or supersession prerequisite.
Fixed K and maximum-cache/90% reduction unproven; new call hasn't appeared in previous input, frozen snapshots guarantee replay independently.
invalid_tool_calls can bypass wrapper; native receive layer, pre-schema dispatcher and optional indexing have separate coverage.
Same attempt/call exact closed JSON spans, no tolerant repair or partial execution; partial parser example and 8419-character failure limits.
Execution/content/package consistency distinct; optional candidates no completion gate; exhausted budget not renewed by resume; local and remote uncertainty differ.
Optional budgeted durable reminder for unexplained stall; explicit cancel/question/stop takes precedence; second stall not automatically awaiting user.
Existing host-callable export; preserve intent for later recovery; no guaranteed all-exit finalizer, no unrelated overwrite, verify actual files and ZIP members.
Durable snapshots/IDs and coalesced progress; OCR completion not conversion; bounded queue can't offer infinite no-loss no-block acceptance; first-line dup2 withdrawn.

topic: Canonical file authority and schema count
summary: Immutable files canonical, SQLite metadata; duplicate mutable blocks_json, four-module/six-table completeness and transferred 228-test proof rejected.
User stops expansion; architecture responsibilities preferred not implemented; three contracts remain open with recommendations, observation/hypothesis distinction and finalization conditions.
Page/region cache signatures with source/tool/engine/language identity, overlap reuse and force_recompute; storage need not split per page, no proven savings or V1 mandate.
Development and source lookup must work from repository files without the original export, old checkout or private scratch.
Explain discussed state/data ownership, interfaces, sequences, failures, rationale, examples and open choices; a source index or copied transcript is insufficient.
Independently compare original terminology, fields, ordering, counterexamples and rejected rationale with maintained explanations; mappings or word matches do not prove detail completeness.
Use accessible direct message text and later corrections as well as export sources; distinguish actual text, summaries and gaps without creating a chat dependency.
